# Understanding

- Existing pipeline reporting lacks granular detail on the lead-to-AUM journey and customer acquisition cost, limiting insight into marketing performance.
- Current reporting does not provide integrated Customer Acquisition Cost (CAC) insights, restricting visibility into marketing ROI.
- Enhanced L2A and CAC data model is required to deliver more actionable and detailed reporting.
- Automation is needed for data ingestion and transformation workflows to support L2A and CAC reporting.
- Mandatory integration with QuickBooks and Salesforce is required to centralize relevant data for reporting.
- Data and technology stakeholders, senior leadership, and marketing teams are primary users of the enhanced reporting system.
- There is a dependency on data access and data quality, particularly related to QuickBooks integration, which may impact project timelines and outcomes.
